clips.send: A parent sends it to whoever is on blood pressure medication - three juices worth trying this week, and the hope of a simple swap.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau walks through what he uses to bring blood pressure down naturally: beet juice, celery juice and carrot juice.

Juicing organic beets yourself raises nitric oxide and oxygen in the body - more energy, and lower blood pressure, he says. No juicer? A dehydrated organic beet crystal powder mixed with water works the same way. Celery juice has to be fresh and organic; carrot juice is fine store-bought if it's cold-pressed and organic.

His point: these are swaps you can make this week, not something you wait months to see work.

Which one would you try first - beet, celery or carrot?
